info.title: Lupin The IIIrd - The Movie: La Stirpe Immortale
info.synopsis: Lupin III e i suoi compagni partono alla volta di un’isola misteriosa nel Mare delle Bermuda, alla ricerca di un grande tesoro e del genio criminale che li ha presi di mira. Dopo essere stati abbattuti in volo, precipitano su un’isola apocalittica, piena di armi abbandonate e avvolta da una nebbia velenosa che uccide in 24 ore. A governarla è Muom, un sovrano che sogna l’immortalità e il dominio sul mondo. Intrappolato e senza via di fuga, Lupin dovrà affidarsi solo alla sua astuzia per sconfiggere un nemico apparentemente invincibile...

episodes.title: LUPIN THE IIIRD: Zenigata and the Two Lupins
episodes.synopsis: Inspector Zenigata encounters a terrorist attack at the airport of the Lobbye, and is surprised that the murderer's face was Lupin III. He soon loses sight of it, but finds another “Lupin” at the station and restrains Lupin on the train, but he allows him to escape with the help of Daisuke Dimension. On the other hand, Mine Fujiko infiltrated the circus troupe and was favored by Supreme Leader Breyn as a rider of the aerial swing. With the disarmament treaty parade just around the corner, the National Security Council Karaskov identified and tracked Lupin as a terrorist and a spy of the United States of Alka, but Zenigata was suspicious. Standing in front of Lupin, who was cornered by the National Security Commission in the capital, was a sengata who believed in his innocence. But at that moment, a new explosion hits the sengata...

episodes.title: Off to Academy City!
episodes.synopsis: Allen's new life in Academy City begins, but an appraisal ceremony unexpectedly puts him on Helmios the Hero's radar.

episodes.title: A New Friend
episodes.synopsis: The No-Life Gamers are off to a good start, but they face a few setbacks: their healer can't join full-time and Krena doesn't know how to use skills.

episodes.title: Conquer the Dungeon
episodes.synopsis: Keel officially joins the No-Life Gamers as they tackle a B-rank dungeon. But as they grow stronger, Allen uncovers a concerning issue regarding his new friend.

episodes.title: An Order from the Prince
episodes.synopsis: A-rank dungeons are dangerous for a reason, as the No-Life Gamers quickly learn. But that's not the only challenge awaiting them.

episodes.title: The Sovereign of Spirits` Prophecy
episodes.synopsis: A new school year brings big changes as three new members join the No-Life Gamers.

episodes.title: Showdown at the Academy Tournament!
episodes.synopsis: Allen faces off against the hero. If he wants to win, he’ll have to use his new summoning abilities.

episodes.title: Onward to Rohzenheim
episodes.synopsis: As the Demon Lord's army lays waste to the Elven Kingdom of Rozenheim, Allen and his friends must find a way to repel the invasion before it's too late.

episodes.title: The Battle of Tiamo
episodes.synopsis: Allen has an unusual request for the Sovereign of Spirits: he wants all of his friends switched over to Hell Mode.

episodes.title: The Demons of Lapolka
episodes.synopsis: The No-Life Gamers must hold the line at Tiamo. But the longer the fighting drags on, the fewer magic stones remain at Allen's disposal.

episodes.title: Plentiful Prayers
episodes.synopsis: The odds are grim. If the No-Life Gamers want to liberate Lapolka, they'll need more than just strategy.

episodes.title: The Liberated
episodes.synopsis: One against a million. If Allen wants to even the odds, he'll have to put his new Deputize skill to the test.

episodes.title: Extra Skill
episodes.synopsis: Allen's party is determined to retake the Elven capital, regardless of what Helmios says.

episodes.title: Summoner of the Beginning
episodes.synopsis: Allen and his friends make their final stand against Rehzel.

info.title: Steins;Gate: Egoistic Poriomania (ITA)
info.synopsis: Episodio sequel degli eventi di Steins;Gate. Rintaro Okabe e gli altri membri del laboratorio stanno facendo un viaggio in America, e vanno ad incontrare Kurisu Makise, la ragazza con la quale ha ideato il forno a microonde in grado di spedire mail nel passato e combattuto il CERN, nel tentativo di salvare Mayushii. Kurisu ha vaghi ricordi di ciò che è accaduto nell'altra linea temporale e Okabe decide di schiarirle le idee, raccontandole tutto, dal passato, a ciò che sarebbe potuto accadere nel futuro.
